feature: GitHub webhook delivery, retained receipt and task status
steps: Deliver a signed local fixture webhook and retain delivery ID.
Lookup the delivery by integration/ID and read receipt/task; replay the same webhook locally.
expected_result: Delivery is authenticated, scoped and deduplicated; receipt/task state tracks the intended work without treating intake as completed execution.
cross_replica_assertion: Repeat N>=3 through the sole caller lane and retain request/event/report/bot IDs plus serving EG, serving AM and owning AM attribution where that step uses them. Show observations on both AMs for AM-backed features; N>=3 alone does not prove distribution. Mark non-AM browser/EG-only steps AM-not-applicable. Preserve retries, duplicate/unknown outcomes, record-revision conflicts and provision 500s per feature; no direct-AM substitution for a platform bot journey.

feature: Organization-owned channel access and owner isolation
entry_point: EG creator API with X-CMAEG-Owner; legacy Console owner selector

feature: Upload admitted event media to AM and append its media continuation
entry_point: EG retained media worker -> original AM binding/conversation/event/attachment slot
steps: Deliver an authorized fixture attachment and retain the exact original target, artifact digest and attachment index.
Read the upload receipt, upload the frozen bytes if needed and submit the matching media supplement; locally replay the exact intent against the peer AM.
expected_result: Receipt identities match the original binding generation, Agent, conversation, event and artifact. A supplement creates or recovers the intended continuation with a distinct response identity; mismatched or changed frozen data is refused and an uncertain upload is reconciled by receipt.
